Applicant :- Sumit Yadav

Counsel for Applicant :- Ali Hasan,Mohd. Suhail,Rajesh P. Singh Baghel Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
Heard Mr. Rajesh P. Singh Baghel, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. Hari Shankar Maurya,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 135 of 2022, under Sections 354, 376-D, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Katka, District Ambedkar Nagar.

In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.

The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 8.8.2022 against one Santosh Yadav and two unknown persons alleging that on 29.07.2022 the named accused person called the informant under the pretext of getting her employed.
The F.I.R. alleges that the aforesaid named accused kept the informant at his home and he started teasing the informant.
The informant further stated that there were two other persons, although no allegation of any misdeed having been committed by other two persons were there in the F.I.R.
In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she reiterated the F.I.R. version and she further stated the named accused forcibly made physical relations with her.

sentences.text: Sumit Yadav (present applicant) and Sonu Yadav committed gang rape on her while the wife of the named accused was present in the house.
In the medico legal examination report of the alleged victim, no injury or sign or use of force has been reported.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the co-accused Sonu Yadav @ Shani Prakash Yadav has already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 17.03.2023, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail application No.3754 of 2023.
The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the incident is alleged to have occurred on 6.8.2022 and the F.I.R. of the incident was lodged by the alleged victim herself on 8.8.2022 but in the F.I.R. there is absolutely no allegation against the applicant and there is no allegation of commission of rape in the F.I.R.; that in the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. there is no such allegation against the applicant and that there are material discrepancies in the version of the alleged victim in the F.I.R. and in her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C and her subsequent statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and also keeping in view that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 15.10.2022 and the co-accused Sonu Yadav @ Shani Prakash Yadav has already been enlarged on bail by this Court, without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am satisfied that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail in the aforesaid case crime.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
